Frequently asked questions

It’s an intelligent wellness tool that combines Ayurvedic wisdom, naturopathy, and AI technology to create personalized health plans. Based on your answers, it suggests customized yoga routines, herbal remedies, and lifestyle tips to help you achieve balance and well-being.

Not at all! Our system provides easy-to-understand explanations, and you don’t need any prior experience. Whether you’re new to Ayurveda or already familiar with it, the assistant adapts to your level.

1️⃣ Take a Quick Quiz – Answer questions about your health, lifestyle, and preferences.

2️⃣ AI Analysis – Our system evaluates your responses using Ayurvedic principles.

3️⃣ Get Your Plan – You receive a detailed, easy-to-follow wellness guide.

4️⃣ Watch & Learn – Access video tutorials for guided exercises and remedies.

5️⃣ Stay Connected – Our bot provides ongoing support and recommendations.
